THE HQ PLANNER — the fleet manager
reads the wires' fields and probes, never raw streams · sets budgets and priorities as constraints · proposes no verb
the sensor at the human interface
the only effector toward people: the pad
built · measured · live hours on the ledger
documents · calls · every lane declares its lag
WIRE DRIVERS ×N — one resident trunk per wire · the continuous driver
reads everything the wire sees · holds every open commitment already read · plans a trajectory per commitment
re-plans on every touch · thinks on a fork when the margin is thin · proposes a verb, a margin, a plan — never disposes
PROBE: the field read off the trunk, the BEV map — where probe and record disagree is a residual
44 ms / judgment on a free card · 27–35B planner beside the 9B judge · 52.7 MB per slot, measured
a deterministic judge over typed fields
beside every driver forever · the null to beat
a class the model cannot beat is compiled
families trained apart · one role each
bound to the effect bytes · a nonce · a TTL
the endpoint is never a required family
THE SEAM — proposals in · one verb out · nothing learned disposes
lattice: wire × class × slot · pressure · ripeness
a fold over the tape · the map the drivers read
THE GATE — deterministic, the last word
3 guard → ask 4 check → wait 5 degraded → draft
6 affirmative clearance · a tie band holds
7 license: rung × band 8 budget: holds, never acts
9 safe terminal at due · silence is never the record
0 off · 1 shadow · 2 canary · 3 wiring · 4 class · 5 exception
up: an anytime-valid test, both sides of the threshold
down: a change detector, an order of magnitude easier
expiry · an audit floor that never reaches zero
kappa ≥ 1 demotes · α_up 0.01 · α_dn 0.10 · n₀ per side
the hand's own reflections are receipts, never grades
predicted trajectory vs actual path grades a hold
the only signal the machine cannot write
state · grades · license · kappa · fronts · contradiction
each a deterministic reduction over the tape, stamped

THE HAND — one writer, the valve
caps aggregate · a first payee asks · egress printed per row
os-enforced sandbox · CUDA inside 281.6 vs 279.4 t/s
the process that acts cannot judge · typed effects only
committed · hash-chained · owned · every fold rebuildable from it · a hold is a row · a refusal is a row
128 B record · BLAKE2b-256 keyed · two witnesses of the head · tape of tapes: every organ's head lands as a row
REV 1 — DRIVER SEATED, DASHED · FTE LEDGER A SKETCH
1 imitation from the shadow tape: what people did, how it turned out
2 reward in the gym: forked futures, scored on the wire's own rewards
3 a pinned weight event · deploy is a widening → a person ratifies
serve bytes · weights · maps · runtime · env pinned as one
the loop learns where mistakes are free, never on the road
a redacted brief to an endpoint · disclosing · counted in bytes and dollars
never required for an irreversible · rent the turn, own the loop
FTE COMPRESSION — the ledger of seats
a sketch the audit replaces · 500-seat headquarters
coordination · 20% · the shared object, no model
content · 15% · a drafting tier with spot review
≈ 46–49% of seats · the first 80 need no model at all
order: coordination first, then processing class by class, then content
measured: adjudication minutes · kappa per class · commitments that waited
the person is not the seat: people move to the residual and the stratum
never adoption · never hours saved · pre-registered before the first number
on record: 46–49% (runbook sketch) vs 10–20% (code read) — unmeasured
systems of record · counterparties · devices · allowlisted hosts
every byte that leaves is printed with its host and its cost
the mind never writes here · only the hand · only through the gate
information flows UP, compressed — streams → field → probe → summary
authority flows DOWN, as constraints — writ → envelopes → budgets → licenses
acts leave only through the gate — the mind never writes to the world · the body never plans
minds propose · the body disposes · people sign
solid — built or measured · dashed — specified, unbuilt · purple — a measured number · green — the seam and the tape
FUSOR node and wire driver are one kind of thing at two radii · the field, gate, hand and tape are the body · the writ is above both
